description: Checking whether a company's revenue engine is ready for its next stage: use this when the person wants to score one company's revenue readiness from its operating metrics (for example ARR, net revenue retention, sales cycle). Returns a Revenue Readiness Index (0-100) with stage fit, confidence, and the #1 growth constraint. Pass the metrics you have; more metrics give higher confidence. For every portfolio company at once, use get_portfolio_readiness_rollup.

companyName.description: Optional label for the company being assessed.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional: any unique string for this call. Retrying with the same key returns the first result and never charges twice.

maxAmountCents.description: Optional: the most this call may cost, in cents. If the price is higher, nothing runs and nothing is charged.

metrics.description: Operating metrics (any subset): arr, mrr, momGrowth or yoyGrowth (%), netRevenueRetention (%), grossMargin (%), monthlyChurn (%), cac, ltv, burnMultiple, customerCount, pipelineValue, salesCycleDays. Percentages as numbers (110 = 110%; 1.1 is read as 110% for retention and margin). The more provided, the higher the confidence.

quoteId.description: Optional: the quote_id from quote, to pay the quoted price (held for 30 minutes).

name: assess_company_readiness
title: Score a company's revenue readiness
